The [[Imperial Dragon Axe]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[axe]] obtained from [[Azume]] in [[Kaineng Center]] after completion of [[The Final Confrontation]] in exchange for an [[Imperial Dragon's Tear]].

==Stats==
: [[Slashing Dmg]]: 6-28 (Requires 9 [[Axe Mastery]])
: Damage +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
: Life draining: 3
: Health regeneration: -1
: Health +30
